PROPOSED GENERIC DIFFERENCE:

The existing verify_safety jq expression requires any unresolvedEntry
to have a terminal NO_PROVIDER_EXECUTION status and reason. For an explicitly
authorized disarmed CODE MAINTENANCE operation ONLY, remove that terminality
requirement from *software installation eligibility*, without editing
historical state or changing live execution/ARM interlocks.

Do NOT add any ticker, client order ID, series ID, or attempt-specific gate.
Do NOT reclassify UNKNOWN. Do NOT clear unresolvedEntry.

The maintenance preflight must fail closed unless ALL are proven:
1. Founder persisted control armed=false, openPositions=0, valid schema,
   required index and unchanged approved control values.
2. Exact source SHA pinned and protected trading files verified.
3. No owned active position or provider-submitting fire latch.
4. An unresolved PRE_PROVIDER_VALIDATION latch is allowed for code
   installation only when writerInvoked===false,
   providerPostStarted===false, providerOrderId==null and
   fireLatch.providerPost==='NOT_STARTED'.
5. Existing authenticated Kalshi account-wide order, fill and position
   reads complete successfully with no active/in-flight obligations
   or unmanaged exposure. Unknown/incomplete reads BLOCK installation.
6. Current coordinator obligations remain guarded; an unknown Durable
   Object claim must not be treated as absent or cleared.
7. Current live Founder control read confirms DISARMED immediately
   before and after installation.
8. KV control/series snapshots and source configuration must match
   before/after installation, except documented scheduler heartbeat.
9. Version/traffic readback must confirm the exact installed build.

The existing script checks KV but has no authenticated Kalshi account-wide
exposure proof or coordinator claim inspection. Therefore simply replacing
the historical terminal predicate in that script is INSUFFICIENT.

The normal ARM/live entry guard, exposure reconciliation, and provider
writer contracts are never changed by this proposed maintenance exception.

NO LIVE GATE PATCH OR INSTALLATION HAS BEEN PREPARED HERE.
A separately reviewed executable gate and authenticated provider
exposure read are mandatory before any Founder-approved installation.
